items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: And our piano player was, his name was Herbert Bloom.

ctx.x: Ida Jackson, did she have a house? Did she have one of the language ladies?
Yeah, she had a house and we used to play there. And our piano player was, his name was Herbert Bloom. He's in California right now. Good piano player.
